items.stem: What is the correct way to update state in a React function component?

options.text: Call the setter returned by useState
options.rationale: Correct: useState returns a setter that triggers a re-render.
Direct reassignment does not trigger a re-render.

options.text: Mutate props passed from the parent
options.rationale: Props are read-only in the child.

options.text: Edit the DOM node by hand
options.rationale: React manages the DOM from state; manual edits are lost on render.

items.explanation: Correct: useState returns a setter that triggers a re-render.

items.stem: Which TWO are true about the useEffect dependency array? (Select TWO.)

options.text: An empty array runs the effect once after the initial render
options.rationale: Correct: [] runs the effect only on mount.

options.text: Listing a value makes the effect re-run when that value changes
options.rationale: Correct: dependencies control when the effect re-runs.

options.text: Omitting the array guarantees the effect runs only once
options.rationale: Omitting it runs the effect after every render.

options.text: The array controls the component's return value
options.rationale: The array controls effect timing, not render output.

items.explanation: Correct: [] runs the effect only on mount.

items.stem: A controlled form input in React derives its value from what?

options.text: Component state, updated via an onChange handler
options.rationale: Correct: controlled inputs bind value to state and update on change.

options.text: The DOM node's internal value only

options.rationale: Server data may seed state but does not make an input controlled.

items.explanation: Correct: controlled inputs bind value to state and update on change.
